items.headline: b14g Hack Drains 97M $CORE, Contracts Paused
items.summary: Bitcoin staking protocol b14g says 97 million $CORE was drained in an exploit. Exchanges froze ~9M $CORE and staked BTC was unaffected.

items.headline: $IPX Token Launches on Base Nov 17 With Atomic Router
items.summary: IPX unveiled its patent-pending atomic router with protected bonding-curve capital ahead of the $IPX token launch on Base Nov 17, plus Coinbase-funded rewards.

items.headline: $OGN Sold at 79% Discount in Binance Hack Chaos
items.summary: Origin pulled 46.74M $OGN from its Curve pool after the Binance attacker dumped $OGN at an average 79% discount. Liquidity has since been restored.

items.headline: Polymarket Resumes After $2.65M Exploit
items.summary: Polymarket lost over $2.5M in minutes via a compromised third-party provider, went cancel-only, and has now resumed trading.

items.headline: $1INCH Slides 13% After Binance Hack Exposure
items.summary: $1INCH fell 13%, underperforming BTC and ETH, after 1inch confirmed its token was among assets stolen in the Binance hack.
